// Compile with the source MavlinkComboBox, Firmwares and ServoFunctionCaptions only; no real device APIs.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Drawing;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows.Forms;
using MissionPlanner.ArduPilot;
using MissionPlanner.Controls;
using MissionPlanner.GCSViews.ConfigurationView;

public static class MAVLink
{
    public sealed class Entry { public double Value; }
    public sealed class MAVLinkParamList : Dictionary<string, Entry> { }
}
namespace MissionPlanner
{
    static class MainV2 { internal static readonly BlockAllWrites comPort = new BlockAllWrites(); }
    sealed class BlockAllWrites
    {
        public int sysidcurrent = 1, compidcurrent = 1;
        public readonly Device MAV = new Device();
        public static int WriteAttempts;
        public bool setParam(int s, byte c, string key, float value) { WriteAttempts++; throw new Exception("no device"); }
    }
    sealed class Device { public readonly State cs = new State(); }
    sealed class State { public Firmwares firmware = Firmwares.ArduCopter2; }
}
namespace MissionPlanner.Utilities
{
    static class ParamWriteQueue
    {
        internal static void Write(string key, float value, object unused, int delay)
        { MissionPlanner.BlockAllWrites.WriteAttempts++; throw new Exception("no writes in probe"); }
    }
    static class ParameterMetaDataRepository
    {
        internal static List<KeyValuePair<int,string>> GetParameterOptionsInt(string a, string b) => throw new Exception("offline fixture");
    }
    static class UiText { public static string Translate(string input) => input; }
    static class Strings { public const string ERROR = "error", ErrorSetValueFailed = "unexpected {0}"; }
    public sealed class MAVLinkParamChanged : EventArgs { public MAVLinkParamChanged(string key, float value) { } }
}
namespace MissionPlanner.Controls
{
    static class CustomMessageBox { public static void Show(string text, string caption) => throw new Exception(text); }
}
internal static class ServoFunctionCaptionsProbe
{
    private static int passed;
    private static KeyValuePair<int,string> Option(int key, string label) => new KeyValuePair<int,string>(key,label);
    [STAThread]
    public static void Main()
    {
        foreach (var culture in new [] { "zh-CN", "zh-Hans", "en-US" })
        foreach (var firmware in new [] { Firmwares.ArduCopter2, Firmwares.ArduPlane, Firmwares.ArduRover, Firmwares.ArduSub, Firmwares.PX4 })
        foreach (int channel in new [] { 1, 16, 32 })
        {
            CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo(culture);
            bool bilingual = culture == "zh-CN" && (firmware == Firmwares.ArduCopter2 || firmware == Firmwares.ArduPlane || firmware == Firmwares.ArduRover);
            var raw = new List<KeyValuePair<int,string>> { Option(138,"Alarm"), Option(0,"Disabled"),
                Option(34,"Motor2"), Option(39,"Motor7/TailTiltServo"), Option(999,"Motor2"), Option(2,"Disabled"), Option(140,"Other") };
            var name = "SERVO" + channel + "_FUNCTION";
            var cache = new MAVLink.MAVLinkParamList { [name] = new MAVLink.Entry { Value = 34 } };
            using (var host = new Form())
            using (var combo = new MavlinkComboBox { Width = 160, WriteInBackground = true, BackgroundWriteDelay = 250 })
            {
                host.Controls.Add(combo); host.Show();
                ServoFunctionCaptions.Attach(combo, raw, firmware);
                combo.setup(raw, name, cache);
                Application.DoEvents();
                var scope = culture + "/" + firmware + "/" + channel;
                Check(scope + " retains metadata list identity/order/original value", ReferenceEquals(combo.DataSource, raw) &&
                    combo.Items.Cast<KeyValuePair<int,string>>().SequenceEqual(raw));
                Check(scope + " retains cached selection/key/binding", combo.SelectedIndex == 2 && (int)combo.SelectedValue == 34 &&
                    combo.ParamName == name && combo.DisplayMember == "Value" && combo.ValueMember == "Key" && cache[name].Value == 34);
                Check(scope + " applies only reviewed option captions", combo.GetItemText(combo.Items[0]) == (bilingual ? "Alarm · 告警" : "Alarm") &&
                    combo.GetItemText(combo.Items[1]) == (bilingual ? "Disabled · 未分配功能" : "Disabled") &&
                    combo.GetItemText(combo.Items[2]) == (bilingual ? "Motor2 · 电机 2" : "Motor2"));
                Check(scope + " unknown/mismatched raw labels remain untouched", combo.GetItemText(combo.Items[3]) == raw[3].Value &&
                    combo.GetItemText(combo.Items[4]) == raw[4].Value && combo.GetItemText(combo.Items[5]) == raw[5].Value &&
                    combo.GetItemText(combo.Items[6]) == raw[6].Value && combo.FormattingEnabled == bilingual);
            }
        }
        Check("no parameter write calls", MissionPlanner.BlockAllWrites.WriteAttempts == 0);
        Console.WriteLine(passed + " checks passed");
    }
    static void Check(string name, bool ok)
    {
        if (!ok) throw new Exception("FAIL " + name);
        passed++;
    }
}
